en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on the Determination of Formless Phenomena: 2.
The Question on the Attainment of Mindfulness of the Qualities of the Buddha.
'If one were to commit unwholesome deeds for a hundred years, yet at the time of death were to obtain mindfulness of even a single quality of the Buddha...'"
“I do not believe that one would be reborn among the gods; nor do I believe that one would be reborn in hell because of a single act of taking life.
“What do you think, Great King? Would even a small stone float upon the water without a boat?”
“What do you think, Great King? Would even a hundred cartloads of stones, when loaded onto a ship, float upon the water?
“Great King, just as a ship, so too should wholesome kamma be regarded.
This is the second question, on the attainment of mindfulness of the Buddha’s qualities.
